tei:div.tei:p: (829)las gang gis sngon du 'gro ba sde brgyad kyi bcos thabs bzhugs so/ (830)

bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ gnas gtsang mar lha bshos/ ri rab/ chang phud/ 'o phud/ me tog sna tshogs/ rtsi sman/ mngar gsum/ sha sna/ sman sna/ 'bru sna dar sna/ zas sna gang 'byor bshams la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ldan pas rang nyid yi dam gang byed du bsgom la/ rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis rlabs nas ting 'jin gyi 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ sku gsum brgyud gsum bla ma dang*/ yi dam zhi khro'i lha (831)tshogs dang*/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ mkha' 'gro nor lha chos bsrung bcas/ mchod yul gong ma thams cad la/ mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ klu yi dbang po dga' bo dang*/ (832)lha min dbang po thag bzang ris/ mi 'am ci ljon rta mgo can/ gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang*/ mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa dang*/ chos skyong ma hā ka la dang*/ dri za zur phud lnga pa sogs/ phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ yab cig bdud rje nag po dang*/ btsan rgyal yam shud dmar po dang*/ yul lha phywa (833)sangs klu sras dang*/ srog bdag rgyal po snying 'byin dang*/ chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar po dang*/ lha mo 'jigs pa'i glog 'byin dang*/ dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dang*/ dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng sogs/ nang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ bdud pho kha thun rakṣa dang*/ gshin rje gshed po dmar po dang*/ klu (834)bdud na ga ra ja dang*/ gnod sbyin shan pa gri thogs pa dang*/ ma mo srid pa'i khram 'debs dang*/ btsan po yam shud srog len dang*/ bdud pho ri ti 'go yag dang*/ srog bdud dung gi thor tsug sogs/

gsang ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ mchod pa dam pa'adi 'bul lo/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ gza' mchog rgyal po rā hur la/ dkar mchog khram shing kha 'thor dang*/ bdud mchog ma (835)nu yaksha dang*/ btsan mchog gri btsan 'thum po dang*/ ma mchog lce spyang dung 'jin dang*/ klu mchog klu rgyal dung skyong dang*/ mgon mchog nag mo ste dkar dang*/ rgyal mchog li byin ha ra sogs/ mchog gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ dpung g.yas dgra lhar sprul pa dang*/ dpung g.yon ma (836)mor sprul pa dang*/ mchu po bdud du sprul pa dang*/ mgo bo srin por sprul pa dang*/ mjug ma dmu ru sprul pa dang*/ lag g.yas gshinarjer sprul pa dang*/ lag g.yon klu btsan sprul pa dang*/ mig dang snying dang mche ba gsum/ gza' bdud nyid du sprul pa dang*/ sprul pa'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ sa bdag hal khyi nag (837)po dang*/ klu bdud sgo ra nag po dang*/ sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*/ phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang*/ mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang*/ pho lha dgra lha srog lha dang*/ mo lha mo sman la sogs pa/ snang srid sde brgyad thams cad la/ mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ ces sair ba bsrung ba dang*/ sri'u gso ba/ mdos (838) glud btang ba/ zor 'phen pa sogs las gang byed kyang sngon du 'gro ba'i sde brgyad mchod pa 'di med na/ byis pa'i mkhar las byed pa dang 'dra/ ces gsungs so/ las gang gi sngon du 'gro ba sde brgyad bcos thabs gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi mjad pa rdzogs so/
